assertions.rationale: Defines `public class TestAuthHandler : AuthenticationHandler<AuthenticationSchemeOptions>` with the standard constructor and HandleAuthenticateAsync override.

assertions.assertion: Includes an ITestClaimsProvider (or equivalent) interface that allows setting claims per-test
The WebApplicationFactory registers the test auth scheme via AddAuthentication and AddScheme
Shows a test that calls ClearClaims (or equivalent) and asserts 401 Unauthorized
Does NOT disable authorization entirely — authorization policies remain active
assertions.rationale: Response explicitly states authorization is left intact and only authentication is replaced, allowing 403 testing.
